recipes.name: Curry Risotto Omurice inspired by Food Wars!
ingredients: bouquet garni (parsley, thyme, and bay leaf)
instructions: For the Beef Broth

In a stock pot, combine the onion, carrots, beef neck bones, and knuckles. Add ginger root and bouquet garni. Fill the pot with enough water to cover all the ingredients. - 1 large onion roughly chopped - 3 large carrots roughly chopped - 3 beef neck bones - 1 beef knuckle bone - 1 fresh ginger root roughly chopped - bouquet garni (parsley thyme, and bay leaf)
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Let it cook for about 1.5 to 2 hours, allowing the flavors to intensify.
Once done, strain the broth through a fine mesh strainer and set aside.
For the Mango Chutney
Start by dicing the mangoes and apples. Peel the apples first and dice them finely. Chop the banana as well. - 2 ripe mangoes finely diced - 2 apples peeled and finely diced - 1 banana finely chopped

Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and chili pepper, sautéing until fragrant. - 2 tbsp vegetable oil - 1 garlic clove minced - 1 chili pepper minced
Add ground coriander and cumin, allowing the spices to bloom in the oil for about 1 minute. - 1 tsp ground coriander - 1 tsp ground cumin

Stir in the diced fruits and sugar. Cook on medium heat until the chutney thickens and the fruits break down into a jam-like consistency. Set aside. - 2 ripe mangoes finely diced - 2 apples peeled and finely diced - 1 banana finely chopped - 200 g sugar
For the Glaze

In a small saucepan, combine honey, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and water. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally until the mixture reduces into a thick glaze. Set aside for later. - 2 tbsp honey - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 2 tbsp oyster sauce - 50 ml water
For the Curry Risotto
In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion and sauté until transluscent. - 30 g butter - 1 white onion finely chopped
Add the ground beef, cooking until browned. Stir in the curry powder and cook for another minute to release the flavors. - 200 g ground beef - 1 tbsp curry powder (preferably homemade)
Add the Arborio rice, stirring it into the beef mixture until the rice grains are coated and slightly toasted. - 200 g Arborio rice
Begin adding the homemade beef broth one ladle at a time, stirring continuously. Allow each addition of broth to be absorbed before adding more. - For the Beef Broth

Once the rice is tender and creamy, stir in the homemade mango chutney and grated Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Set the risotto aside to cool slightly. - For the Mango Chutney - 50 g parmesan cheese grated - Salt and pepper to taste
For the Omelet
Crack the eggs into a mixing bowl. Add the cream and milk, and blend with a whisk or an immersion blender until smooth. - 5 ½ eggs - 50 ml cream - 50 ml whole milk
Heat a nonstick pan over medium-high heat and add a knob of butter. Once the butter is melted, pour in the egg mixture. - butter
Cook the eggs, gently stirring until they begin to set. Stop stirring when the curds just begin to set. Leave in the pan for assembly.
For the Assembly
Using a mold or your hands, shape the cooled risotto into a football shape. - For the Curry Risotto
Carefully place the risotto onto the the barely set eggs in the pan, then fold the eggs over to create a blanket. - For the Omelet - For the Curry Risotto
Gently slide the Omurice onto a serving plate seam side down.
Drizzle the prepared glaze over the top of the Omurice, creating a crosshatch pattern. - For the Glaze
Garnish with a parsley leaf. - fresh parsley for garnish
Serve and enjoy.
